title: Sausage Wrap Delight
description: A simple and delicious wrap filled with sausage, served with a side of delight.

ingredients.name: wrap
ingredients.notes: flour tortilla or any other type of wrap

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the sausage into thin rounds.
Grill the sausage for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, slice the kabanos into thin rounds.
Grill the kabanos for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly toasted.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of sausage and kabanos onto each wrap.
